category_two_levels.name: category_two_levels
category_two_levels.value: "categories"."parent_depth" = 0 AND (("categories"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "categories"."depth" = 0) OR ("categories"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "categories"."depth" = 1))

item_money_valid.name: item_money_valid
item_money_valid.value: "order_items"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND "order_items"."unit_price_minor" > 0 AND ("order_items"."unit_cost_minor" IS NULL OR "order_items"."unit_cost_minor" >= 0) AND "order_items"."line_total_minor" = "order_items"."unit_price_minor" * "order_items"."quantity" AND "order_items"."line_total_minor" <= 9007199254740991

offer_money_valid.name: offer_money_valid
offer_money_valid.value: "product_market_offers"."price_minor" > 0 AND "product_market_offers"."price_minor" <= 9007199254740991 AND ("product_market_offers"."compare_at_price_minor" IS NULL OR ("product_market_offers"."compare_at_price_minor" >= "product_market_offers"."price_minor" AND "product_market_offers"."compare_at_price_minor" <= 9007199254740991)) AND ("product_market_offers"."cost_minor" IS NULL OR ("product_market_offers"."cost_minor" >= 0 AND "product_market_offers"."cost_minor" <= 9007199254740991))

published_page_has_content.name: published_page_has_content
published_page_has_content.value: "product_pages"."status" <> 'published' OR ("product_pages"."published_config" IS NOT NULL AND "product_pages"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

product_category_valid.name: product_category_valid
product_category_valid.value: "products"."category_depth" = 0 AND ("products"."subcategory_id" IS NULL OR "products"."category_id" IS NOT NULL)

market_identity_check.name: market_identity_check
market_identity_check.value: ("store_markets"."country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "store_markets"."custom_key" IS NULL) OR ("store_markets"."country_code" IS NULL AND "store_markets"."custom_key" IS NOT NULL AND length("store_markets"."custom_key") > 0)
